intro: Lady Death Demonicron is a side-scrolling hack and slash for fans of the golden age of arcade gaming.
description:
All Lady Death wants is to mourn a fallen friend in peace. Then an infernal portal rips open and a throng of demon scum storms the cemetery gates. Little does Lady Death know, the most brutal battle of her undead life has just begun.

Malevolent forces tear Lady Death from one realm to another... From the stinking pits of Hell, to an undead heavy metal festival, to a demonic dinosaur catastrophe, to a cannibalistic, industrial nightmare. Through it all, one true ally stands at her side: Ravenheart, a haunted warrior armed with a savage sword and the touch of death, but will even his strength be enough?

Lady Death Demonicron is an all new side-scrolling, sword-slicing, magic-wielding, 15 level co-op hack and slash that takes the best aspects of the 1990s arcade classics all mixed together with a killer industrial-metal soundtrack.
